articles.title: Switch 2 Lite rumored with cheaper Samsung chip process benefiting Nintendo console
articles.description: Samsung reportedly will introduce an 8LPU+ chip process that may impact the Nvidia T239 SoC. Cheaper to produce, it’s a candidate for the rumored Switch 2 Lite console. Rising storage and memory prices have complicated the prospect of a more affordable Nintendo handheld.

articles.title: Lab study shows needle-free mRNA vaccine protects against COVID and flu
articles.description: A needle-free vaccination method protected mice against the viruses that cause COVID-19 and flu, offering a possible new way to deliver mRNA vaccines while limiting unwanted inflammation.

articles.title: Capcom suffered a data breach involving 11.7 million user records
articles.description: The Japanese company Capcom has reported a large-scale data breach involving its Capcom ID service. A total of 11.7 million records were compromised, and the attackers managed to change the passwords on 196 accounts.

articles.title: GPUs from stolen $470,000 Nvidia RTX 5090 shipment at Brazil airport appear for sale online, identified by serial numbers
articles.description: One of the GPUs from a stolen shipment of RTX 5090 graphics cards has appeared for sale online. Police have identified three employees at an airport who stole the goods.
